t: Display work queue status at wakeup Step 9 — ready count, refinement count, and work/review/skip offer
perceive: 1. Read templates/commands/wai.md Step 7-8 — where the briefing ends and session starts. 2. Confirm _work_queue exists in WAI-State.json (from task-work-queue-schema-and-state). 3. Count ready vs needs_refinement items.
execute: 1. Add Step 9 to wai.md (after Initialize Session): if _work_queue is non-empty, display: 'Work Queue: {N} ready, {M} needs refinement'. 2. Show top 3 ready items by priority with one-line summaries. 3. Offer: '[W]ork next ready item / [R]eview refinements / [S]kip queue'. 4. If queue is empty: skip Step 9 silently. 5. Sync wai.md to all targets.
verify: 1. With populated queue: wakeup shows queue summary + offer. 2. With empty queue: no queue section appears. 3. Selecting [W] starts the top priority ready item.

_behavior_directive.what_this_is: Wakeup presentation of the work queue — display and offer, not queue logic
_behavior_directive.what_this_is_NOT: Not implementing the queue itself (that's task-work-queue-schema-and-state) or chain mode
